message: Built for Nicky (ncy.ai) from the real .ai Agent-ID mint workflow. Live findings from the demo: Pokechain's X handle is currently a 404 (caught by the agent), AGCC mint scores 75/100 CAUTION. Try the demo with the AGCC mint contract 0x6288DFe86f22B53eEB6886aE2D78941de7483743.
title: MintGuard — mint-safety verification agent for .ai Agent IDs
whatItDoes: MintGuard verifies .ai Agent-ID mints on BSC before you spend. Give it a mint contract (+ optional expected price and X handle) and it runs 10+ live probes: contract exists, source verified on Sourcify, owner renounced, paused, exact mint price in BNB, supply cap, sale open, mint entry reachable, royalty, reveal — plus an X-account check (dead handle = BLOCK; unverifiable history is never claimed clean). It answers GO / CAUTION / BLOCK with a 0-100 score and per-check evidence, pinned to the BSC block so anyone can reproduce the verdict. Built from the real verification workflow used for Agent-ID mints (AGCC, Pokechain, MetaFishtank). Zero dependencies, read-only (never signs or spends), no API keys. The endpoint above runs the same checks in your browser; the repo has the Node server (POST /verify) and a Vercel serverless build. Cannot prove an X account was never rebranded (X hides name history) — it reports that as unverifiable. BSC mainnet only.
